map.五种方法估算创业公司估值（投前），输出综合估值范围。金额单位：万元人民币: Five methods to estimate a startup's valuation (pre-money), outputting a combined valuation range. Amounts in units of 10,000 CNY
map.「五种方法估算创业公司估值（投前），输出综合估值范围。金额单位：万元人民币」按输: Five methods to estimate a startup's valuation (pre-money) and output a combined range by professional calculation from the input parameters.
map.用多种方法交叉验证：Berkus（5 要素各 ≤500 万，合计上限 2500: Cross-validate with several methods: Berkus (5 factors each at most 5,000,000 CNY, total cap 25,000,000 CNY), scorecard (base valuation x weighted deviation), venture capital method (back out pre-money/post-money), DCF (discounted cash flow plus perpetual terminal value), and transaction comparables (PS multiples / value per user).
map.早期项目单一方法误差大，应同时跑 2–3 种方法取区间，避免被某一口径锚定；DC: A single method has large error for early-stage projects, so run 2-3 methods and take a range to avoid being anchored by one basis; DCF is sensitive to assumptions and suits growth-stage companies with stable cash flow.
map.风险投资法用退出倍数倒推：投后 = 退出价值 ÷ (1+年化回报率)^年限，投前: The venture capital method works backwards from an exit multiple: post-money = exit value / (1 + annualized return)^years, pre-money = post-money - this round's investment, and it also computes the investor's stake.
map.Berkus：5 要素各 300 万 → 1500 万（上限 2500 万）。\:
Berkus: 5 factors at 3,000,000 CNY each → 15,000,000 CNY (cap 25,000,000 CNY).
Scorecard: base 20,000,000 CNY, 7 factors deviation weighted +5% → 21,000,000 CNY.
Venture capital method: exit 80,000,000 CNY, return multiple 1.4, 4 years, this round 15,000,000 CNY → annualized rate 0.4, post-money = 80,000,000/1.4^4 = 20,825,000 CNY, pre-money = 5,825,000 CNY, investor stake = 72.0%.
DCF: 5-year cash flow (5,000,000 → 12,440,000 CNY, g=20%), discounted at 12%, perpetual growth 3% → present value of each period totals 30,895,000 CNY plus present value of terminal value 80,794,000 CNY = 111,690,000 CNY.
Transaction comparables: revenue 20,000,000 CNY x PS(3~8) = 60,000,000-160,000,000 CNY; the per-user method (monthly active users 3,000,000 x 30~80 CNY) serves as a cross-check giving 0.9-2.4 (10,000 CNY units).
The combined range is about 5,820,000-160,000,000 CNY; use the multi-method average as the starting point for negotiations.
map.早期项目该用哪种估值法？: Which valuation method suits an early-stage project?
map.极早期用 Berkus/记分卡（看团队与要素打分）最稳；有收入后用风险投资法倒推: For very early stages Berkus or the scorecard (team and factor scoring) is most reliable; once there is revenue, use the venture capital method to back out; at growth stage add DCF and PS comparables. Every single method skews one way, so run at least two for cross-validation.
map.风险投资法里回报率怎么定？: How is the return rate set in the venture capital method?
map.回报率 = 退出倍数 − 1（如 10 倍退出 → 年化 9，过于激进）。实务中: Return rate = exit multiple - 1 (for example a 10x exit gives an annualized 9, which is too aggressive). In practice an annualized return of 20%~40% over 3-5 years is common for early stages (that is, a multiple of 1.2~1.4); a multiple that is too high back-solves to a negative pre-money valuation, so revisit the parameters.
map.五种方法并行：Berkus 法为价值主张、技术、执行、市场、落地五项各钳制 0–: Five methods run in parallel: the Berkus method clamps each of the five factors (value proposition, technology, execution, market, traction) to 0–5 million CNY and sums them, capped at 25 million; the scorecard method = baseline average × (1 + Σ weight × (factor − 100) ÷ 100), with weights in order 0.30 / 0.25 / 0.15 / 0.10 / 0.10 / 0.05 / 0.05; the VC method discount rate = target return multiple − 1, post-money valuation = exit value ÷ (1 + discount rate)^years, pre-money valuation = post-money − this-round investment, ownership = investment ÷ post-money × 100%; DCF takes the base-year (prior-year) free cash flow as input, year-t cash flow = prior year × (1 + growth rate), present value = cash flow ÷ (1 + discount rate)^t, terminal value present value = year-n cash flow × (1 + perpetual growth rate) ÷ (discount rate − perpetual growth rate) ÷ (1 + discount rate)^n, valuation = sum of period present values + terminal value present value, requiring the discount rate to be greater than 0 and the perpetual growth rate to be below the discount rate; the comparables method PS valuation = revenue × multiple range, and the per-user method valuation = monthly active users (in ten-thousands) × value per user (CNY) (in ten-thousands). The summary counts one vote for each method (comparables use the range midpoint) and separately shows the minimum, maximum and average of each method representative value.
map.预测未来 N 年自由现金流，按折现率折现求和，加上终值（永续增长法）。适合已有稳: Projects free cash flow for the next N years, discounts it at the discount rate, sums it, and adds the terminal value (perpetual-growth method). Suited to businesses with stable existing revenue. The cash flow input is the base-year (prior-year) value and grows at the growth rate from year 1 onward.
map.综合估值每种方法计一票（对标法取区间中值，区间上下限单独展示），取各法代表值的最: The summary counts one vote per method (comparables use the range midpoint; the range bounds are shown separately), taking the minimum / maximum / average of each method's representative value. Choose 1–2 primary methods for your company's stage and use the rest as cross-checks.
